## Description

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)

- [ ] Hardhat smart contract tests (`npx hardhat test`)
- [ ] Local frontend build verification (`npm run build`)
